_comment: Where nothing has to agree with anything else. The biomes stop following the land (`footing: free`), and
everything leans towards the fantastic: land that floats or hangs inverted, colour, glow, things aloft and
mushroom woods, creatures that fly rather than bite.
Three of a soft haze tinted a colour no air is, a rainbow in a clear sky, pastel sky and cloud, motes of
light and petals drifting, a second sun, a vast moon and brighter stars are offered to every dreamlike Age,
each yielding to anything the book says.
